data.summary:
**When:** [Your Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), after one of your **BRÔKHYR**, **IRONKIN STEELJACKS** or **ARKANYST EVALUATOR** units has shot.

**Target:** That same **BRÔKHYR**, **IRONKIN STEELJACKS** or **ARKANYST EVALUATOR** unit.

**Effect:** If the unit [Remained Stationary](vsdata:core-rule/remain-stationary) earlier in the turn, during [your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), it can now make a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move).

effects.condition: unit Remained Stationary in your Movement phase this turn
